justification: Solution A spells out every required semantic in verifiable plain BCL — SemaphoreSlim as the bound, indexed writes for source order, TaskCompletionSource.TrySetResult for the first-observed winner, and explicit early returns/branches for empty and all-declined cases. Solution B delegates the bound and winner selection to SelectParallelValueAsync/FirstSuccessAsync (semantics only asserted in comments) and adds Effect/Result/Match ceremony plus an intermediate Reservation record; its Match branch does make the all-declined case read clearly, but the empty-items case and exception aggregation are library-implicit.
